_comment: Albums' listing in Kayden's Source (apps.kaydenpmd.net), which is built from Ammy's repo. publish-source.yml puts this 'app' block together with the source-wide settings in Ammy's own source.config.json, then runs Ammy's scripts/build_source.py against Ammy's public/source.json. Everything here is re-applied on every release, so a fix here goes live with the next one. appPermissions has to list every entitlement in the app and its share extension: AltStore refuses to install an app whose source didn't declare one, and SideStore would too if the source ever set "version": 2 (SideStore checks only sources with version >= 2, and Kayden's Source has no version key).

app.name: Albums
app.subtitle: Save Apple Music albums for later
app.localizedDescription:
Albums is a place to stash Apple Music albums you want to listen to later. It looks like Apple Music's own Library: a two-column grid of artwork.

SAVE FROM APPLE MUSIC. On an album or a song, tap Share, then Albums. Or paste a link.

LISTEN WHEN YOU'RE READY. Tap an album to open it in Apple Music. Mark albums as listened, and filter the grid to what you haven't heard yet.

Album details come from Apple's own catalog, looked up by the album's ID, never guessed.

IF SIDESTORE ASKS ABOUT APP EXTENSIONS, KEEP THEM. The share extension is what puts Albums in the Share menu; without it, albums can only be added by pasting a link.

Requires iOS 26 or later.
